editorial.unverified_gloss:
Given a self-map `T : X → X`, relations `U` and `V` on `X`, and a dynamical cover `v` for `T` with respect to the composed entourage `U ∘ V` at time `n`, this theorem concludes that `∃ c, 1 = c * Dynamics.netMaxcard u v Set.univ n`—a roundabout way of stating that `Dynamics.netMaxcard u v Set.univ n = 1`. 

The hypotheses on `U`, `V`, and the nonemptiness of the composed `n`-step dynamical entourages are only used to transport the cover property via monotonicity and deduce that `v` is nonempty, after which `Dynamics.netMaxcard_univ` evaluates the maximal cardinality on `Set.univ` to `1`.
